name: use-milume
description: Drive milume's LandmarksWidget from Python in a notebook: open it with milume.peek, recolour with w.color, read the cells in a region with w.get_obs_names, match plot colours with category_colors, write landmarks to or from a GeoDataFrame / SpatialData, and open, move or close the 3D Inspect cube. Use when an agent writes notebook code against milume (AnnData or SpatialData spatial omics).
